facts.statement: The fossils consist of three well-preserved but incomplete dorsal vertebrae.
facts.quote: The fossils, consisting of three fossil dorsal (back) vertebrae, are well-preserved but incomplete.

facts.statement: The fossils were discovered in the Anacleto Formation of Neuquén province, western Argentina.
facts.quote: They were discovered in the Anacleto Formation of the Neuquén province of western Argentina.

facts.statement: The genus name Barrosasaurus honors the Sierra Barrosa in Neuquén.
facts.quote: The genus name is named after the Sierra Barrosa in Neuquén.

facts.statement: The specific epithet casamiquelai honors the Argentinian paleontologist Rodolfo Magín Casamiquela.
facts.quote: The specific epithet honours the Argentinian paleontologist Rodolfo Magín Casamiquela.

facts.statement: Barrosasaurus is estimated to have been 18 meters long and weighed 13.5 tonnes.
facts.quote: It has been estimated to be 18 meters (60 ft) in length and 13.5 tonnes (14.9 short tons) in weight.

facts.statement: Barrosasaurus belongs to the parent group Titanosauria.
Barrosasaurus is classified in the class Saurischia.
Barrosasaurus lived from the Turonian to the Campanian stages, between 93.9 and 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Turonian to Campanian (93.9 to 72.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Barrosasaurus is a genus of titanosaurian sauropod dinosaur first described by Leonardo Salgado and Rodolfo Coria in 2009.
rejected.quote: Barrosasaurus is a genus of titanosaurian sauropod dinosaur, first described by paleontologists Leonardo Salgado and Rodolfo Coria in 2009.
